sources.title: Explanation and exact formula of Zipf's law evaluated from rank-share ...
sources.snippet: ABSTRACT This work proves that ranks and shares are statistically dependent on one another, based on simple combinatorics. It presents a formula for rank-share distribution and illustrates that Zipf's law, is descended from expected values of various ranks in the new distribution.
